bull.point: Profit is growing significantly faster than revenue alongside strong capital efficiency and high cash generation.
bull.evidence: 3-year profit CAGR is 24.2% vs revenue CAGR of 7.4%, ROCE stands at 31.0%, and CFO to PAT averaged over 100% (114.45% in Mar 2026).

bull.point: Strong underlying operational cash flow supports growth with virtually no balance sheet leverage.
bull.evidence: Practically debt-free with D/E at 0.03 and generated ₹2,828 Cr CFO alongside ₹2,239 Cr FCF in Mar 2026.

bull.point: Management is confident in sustaining double-digit volume growth and strong margin targets via planned price hikes.
bull.evidence: Nov 2026 guidance targets double-digit UVG growth, EBITDA margins at the higher end of 20%-24%, and 3%-5% price hikes in inflated areas.

bear.point: Operating margin experienced recent quarter-on-quarter compression due to raw material cost pressure.
bear.evidence: Latest-quarter OPM fell to 20.0% in Sep 2026 compared to 26.0% in Jun 2026 and 24.0% in Sep 2025.

bear.point: Valuation key metrics remain high relative to basic earnings and book value.
bear.evidence: Stock P/E stands at 57.9 with a Book Value of ₹110 against a market price of ₹1,526.

bear.point: Raw material inflation and new competitive threats pose risks to product margins.
bear.evidence: Analyst concerns highlight VAM price surges, raw material inflation impact, and entry of the largest paint company into VAM/VAE facilities.

watch_next: Sustainability of operating margins within the 20%-24% target corridor given raw material inflation.
Realization of 3%-5% price increases and its impact on maintaining double-digit underlying volume growth.
Impact of VAM price surges and new competitor VAM/VAE capacity on input costs.
